title: Zero test on the zero polynomial
statement: Let $C$ be an algebraic circuit on $n$ inputs whose associated polynomial over $\mathbb{Z}$ is zero. Then for every Boolean string $r$, the circuit's zero test on $r$ returns true.
hypotheses_covered: The circuit's associated polynomial is zero
